hooks.name: Remind to rebuild WASM and starters
hooks.description: Reminds the agent that the committed WASM and starter bundles must be rebuilt after source changes.

action.prompt: A Rust crate or the spirit templates changed. Before finishing: run `bun run build:wasm` if Rust changed (the committed apps/web/public/wasm must match the source), and run `bun scripts/pack-starters.ts` if templates.ts changed, so the preloaded starter spirits match.
